# helpmehack

> helpmehack is an open-source discovery platform for developers looking for active repositories, contribution programs, beginner-friendly issues, and project-specific contribution rules.

Canonical site: https://www.helpmehack.tech
GitHub: https://github.com/rohanmalhotracodes/helpmehack

## Primary pages

- https://www.helpmehack.tech/ — main discovery experience
- https://www.helpmehack.tech/open-source-projects — guide to finding open-source projects to contribute to
- https://www.helpmehack.tech/programs — open-source program directory, including GSoC and Summer of Bitcoin
- https://www.helpmehack.tech/contribute — contribution guidance
- https://www.helpmehack.tech/contribute/first-issue — first-contribution guidance

## What helpmehack provides

helpmehack helps contributors compare:
- active open-source repositories
- contribution and issue-assignment rules
- beginner-friendly issues
- repository activity and maintenance signals
- Google Summer of Code organization history
- participation years and past projects
- technologies used by participating organizations
- source links for verification

## Source and freshness guidance

Repository and program information may change. Prefer the source links shown on helpmehack pages for current GitHub or official program details. Treat helpmehack as a discovery and comparison layer, not as a replacement for maintainers' latest instructions.

## Crawling

Public pages may be crawled and cited. API routes are not intended as public indexable pages.
